items.title: Liverpool bevestigt investering van Amazon-oprichter Bezos
items.summary: Een consortium met Amazon-oprichter Jeff Bezos als een van de drijvende krachten gaat investeren in Liverpool, zo bevestigt de club vrijdagavond. Liverpool spreekt van een minderheidsbelang. Engelse media melden dat het consortium een derde van de aandelen verwerft.

items.title: Nederlandse verdediger (23) maakt in België transfer voor ruim een miljoen euro
items.summary: Luc Marijnissen maakt een mooie transfer in België. De 23-jarige verdediger verruilt Dender voor KV Mechelen, dat ruim een miljoen euro voor hem betaalt. Dat werd eerder al gemeld op deze site .

items.title: Wegvallen Thomas Didillon-Hödl zet transferplannen Willem II onder druk
items.summary: De zware hamstringblessure van Thomas Didillon-Hödl stelt Willem II voor een onverwacht dilemma op de transfermarkt. Trainer John Stegeman hoopt een nieuwe doelman te mogen verwelkomen, maar beseft dat daar een prijskaartje aan hangt. 'Dan zul je ergens anders een veer moeten laten.'

items.title: Chelsea expect Enzo Fernández to stay after Manchester City opt not to meet deadline
items.summary: City could maintain interest despite lack of bid Maresca expecting busy end to transfer window Manchester City did not make a £120m bid for Enzo Fernández before Chelsea’s 5pm deadline on Friday but Enzo Maresca still expects a busy end to the transfer window, as the club seek incomings and outgoings. Chelsea, meanwhile, now expect the Argentina midfielder to stay at Stamford Bridge. Maresca takes charge of City for the first time in a major match on Sunday against Arsenal in Cardiff in the Community Shield but is a long way from finalising the squad he will have for the season. Fernández, who played under Maresca at Chelsea, remains a target for City, who could still test the water despite missing the deadline. Continue reading...

items.title: Hamer krijgt lachers op zijn hand na terugkeer bij Coventry
items.summary: Gustavo Hamer is terug bij Coventry City . De Premier League-promovendus neemt de middenvelder over van Sheffield United. Hamer speelde eerder al voor The Sky Blues . Zijn presentatie via de sociale kanalen van zijn nieuwe club leverde opmerkelijke beelden op.

items.title: Chelsea say no Fernandez move as deadline passes - but is it really over?
items.summary: Chelsea's deadline for clubs to bid £120m for midfielder Enzo Fernandez has passed - and they now expect the Argentine to stay at the club this season.

items.title: Liverpool owner FSG seals £1.65bn sale of 30% stake to consortium including Jeff Bezos
items.summary: Confirmed deal values club as a whole at £5.5bn Amit Bhatia will become club’s new vice-chairman Liverpool’s owner, Fenway Sports Group, has confirmed it has agreed the sale of 30% of the club to a consortium including Amit Bhatia, the Amazon founder Jeff Bezos and the Facebook co-founder Eduardo Saverin. The deal is understood to be worth £1.65bn, valuing Liverpool at £5.5bn, and will see Bhatia become the club’s new vice-chair on an expanded board. Bhatia, the son-in-law of Indian steel magnate Lakshmi Mittal, initiated and led talks with FSG on behalf of the 1892 Holdings consortium, a reference to Liverpool’s founding year. The former co-owner of Queens Park Rangers has received financial backing from the Mittal Family Trust, the K5 Sports fund, of which Bezos is the lead investor, and EE Capital, the family office of Elaine and Eduardo Saverin. Continue reading...

items.title: Bezos-backed consortium buys a third of Liverpool
items.summary: Liverpool's owners agree to sell around a third of the club to a consortium including billionaire Amazon founder Jeff Bezos - in a deal that values the Reds at more than £5bn.

items.title: Continental clash: where world football stands on Fifa and Infantino – explained
items.summary: With Oceania praising Fifa on Friday, all six confederations have finally had their say on the fallout from the World Cup sell-off plan The Oceania Football Confederation’s (OFC) decision to belatedly issue a statement following this week’s executive committee meeting praising Fifa’s “progress achieved over the last decade” means all six continental confederations have finally had their say on the fallout from the World Cup sell-off plan that has split world football, with the votes seeming tied at three apiece on the key issue of whether Gianni Infantino should remain as Fifa president. Continue reading...

items.title: Arsenal open talks with Bayer Leverkusen over deal for Jarell Quansah
items.summary: Bundesliga club want at least €50m for England defender Gunners remain interested in Aston Villa’s Ezri Konsa Arsenal have opened talks with Bayer Leverkusen over a move for Jarell Quansah as they intensify efforts to bring in cover for William Saliba and Jurriën Timber. The England defender, who left Liverpool last summer for an initial £30m and was part of Thomas Tuchel’s World Cup squad, has been identified as an ideal replacement for the France and Netherlands defenders, who will miss the start of the new season due to injury. While Quansah’s preferred position is in central defence, he was also deployed at right-back by Tuchel at the World Cup and was sent off in the last-16 victory over Mexico. Continue reading...
